limits: Source geometry and public physical collision alignment remain independent and provisional.
Five boom samples do not prove a continuous visibility corridor around every thin object; camera-endpoint triangle clearance is exact for eligible static triangle meshes within each query pass.
Camera clearance runs at most three correction passes; overlapping malformed source surfaces enclosing the subject may remain obstructed.
Native triangle queries ignore texture alpha and can conservatively retract through foliage cutouts.
The existing scoped first-person camera override remains unchanged.
Non-triangle/skeletal/morph geometry uses native ray picking and does not get exact static endpoint triangle clearance.

First dense immutable-mesh query builds bounded in-memory index partitions and Babylon native Vector3 position caches. Cold allocation cost remains; hidden enabled meshes can retain native point arrays until geometry release even after camera partition eviction.
repair: Mutable position/index buffers use fresh native closest-hit picking and uncached endpoint partitions.
Immutable geometry entries validate native position/index buffer identities in addition to native array/submesh identity.
Four native regressions cover actual in-place vertex deformation, tiny deformed endpoint blockers, updatable indices, and immutable buffer replacement.
